displayIdentity.body: Timothy is sent because Paul can no longer bear uncertainty. Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone, For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
